answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the timber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The zephyr lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the juniper is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
